notes.title: CTHULOOT - 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello looters!
We are continuing our series of bug fixes.

[h2]Features[/h2]

- Tweaked sounds, musics, volumes.
(Please support the awesome of Corentin Brasart: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655300/CTHULOOT_Soundtrack/)

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

- Fixed gem not visible in level 11 room 17
- Fix players not attached to controlled ship platforms
- Fix save data erased because we were not taking the best score 
- Fix achievement "A Place to Be" (you may have to swap with another character in the hub to trigger it)

notes.title: CTHULOOT - 1.0.1

- Updated credits

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

notes.title: THE CTHULOOT DEMO IS AVAILABLE, PLAY IT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello Cthulooters, we are happy to present you the first playable demo of our game CTHULOOT.

Play with your friends and discover the demo content:

[list]
[*] 4 characters (+1 unlockable)
[*] 4 levels
[*] 2 biomes: the Underworld Crypt & the Haunted Cove
[*] 30+ rooms filled with traps and puzzles
[*] 30+ items and mechanisms to combine
[*] 1 hour of gameplay
[/list]

[h3]Follow our tiny dev team:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/FwUwUchAhw]On Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/pixelnest]On X[/url]
[/list]

We're really excited to show you what we've been cooking. We hope you're just as excited.
